record.paperId: Old_Questions/LDE_2024-2026/LDE, Assistant Director of Survey under Land Revenue Settlement March-2026 Paper-III..pdf
record.question: A Periodic Patta holder is not allowed to:
options: Regularise his Patta into Land Settlement Certificate.
record.explanation: A periodic patta is a temporary grant that does not permit transfer, so a holder cannot mutate the land-holding in the record; this option is the restriction among the four.
